content: I'm fed up with sitting on packing cases, Joe. Don't you think we should buy at least two chairs?
Do you know how much new chairs cost? One cheap comfortable armchair is eighty pounds.
Yes, I know. It's terrible. But I have an idea. Why don't we look for chairs at a street market? I've always wanted to see one.
All right. Which one shall we go to?
Portobello Road, I think. There are a lot of secondhand things there. And we'll have to go tomorrow. It's only open on Saturdays.
What time do you want to go? Not too early. I hope.
The guidebook says the market is open from nine to six. It's a very popular market, so we'd better be there when it opens.
